content:
Learn about the Inoculation Project by accessing the Responders laboratory terminal, located on the second floor of the third airport hangar, near the area where Collision Course takes place.

Once the entry is read, the quest is complete. The Final Departure achievement/trophy is unlocked after the first completion and the player is awarded the Somerset Special.

Investigate Morgantown Airport

I learned that the Responders were headquartered at Morgantown Airport. It seems like a good place to search for clues about what happened to them.

?

Learn the fate of the Responders

While exploring the old Responder base at Morgantown Airport, I spotted a holotape. I should listen to it.

While exploring the old Responder base at Morgantown Airport, I found a holotape with a recording made by the Overseer. She suggested checking out a nearby terminal to learn about the Responders inoculation project.

Notes[]

There are four holotapes that will only appear when this quest is active. They cannot be acquired before the quest starts or after its completion.

All of the aforementioned holotapes will disappear upon the quest's completion. Maria's last words, in particular, may disappear before the player character's own eyes if it is not picked up during the quest.
